body: Sandbox VM ready for automation. Guest user sandboxpenguins (admin, passwordless sudo via /etc/sudoers.d), key-only ssh from ~/.mitosis/field-notes/sandbox. Guest automatic updates, sleep and screen saver off. A relay in a Terminal window (LaunchAgent sbx.runner opens it at login) runs commands in the desktop session; Terminal holds Accessibility, PostEvent and ScreenCapture (tcccheck: all true). Isolation proof: host listen-only watch for 30 s while the guest typed 'Isolation proof typed inside the guest 123' into TextEdit (84 key events, 40 mouse moves): host saw software-events=0 and 1373 hardware events (counted only); host frontmost changed to the Parallels VM window and back to Claude during the window, attributed to the owner's own clicks (only hardware input was seen). prlctl snapshot-list is refused on Standard ('available only in Pro or Business'), so snapshot restore and VM start are the owner's clicks.
